provenance.notes: CVE-2026-12044 (9.16, commit 658bb58): qtLiteral silently returned the raw unescaped value when conn was falsy and swallowed adapt errors; fix made it raise on missing conn and switched 16 COMMENT ON / pgstattuple / pgstatindex templates to qtLiteral. Residual CVE-2026-17346: the index Statistics template coll_stats.sql still interpolated schemaname = '{{schema}}' AND stat.relname = '{{table}}' (allowlisted in test_sql_string_literal_lint.py on the wrong assumption that pg_catalog names cannot contain apostrophes). A user with CREATE privilege plants a table named with the UNION payload; opening the Indexes Statistics node executes it. Fixed in 9.17 (commit 73b3218) with {{ schema|qtLiteral(conn) }}. Seed PoC: create DOMAIN with apostrophe-injection description -> COMMENT ON DOMAIN IS '...' breakout -> error-based exfil of pcb_secret via CAST. Built 2026-08-01.
